title: Marlin SE daily checks and customer setup scratchpad
content:
2026-03-10 morning dump:

Context: Marlin Co — regulated fintech prototype. Private deployment in EU-west-1 single-VPC with HSM KMS. Primary ask: deterministic latency <120ms p90 for 1:1 chat workload (avg 40 tok/response) and data residency.

Goals for this sprint:
- Finish VPC peering & routing (customer VPC -> Redwood-managed worker subnets)
- Validate model quantization profile for 8-bit int on A10G equivalent hardware
- Canary rollout plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic fallback to hosted small model on overload
- Document incident runbook and escalation chain for Marlin SOC

Notes to self (quick):
- Ask infra to reserve dedicated private endpoints in eu-west-1-az a/b/c, confirm ENI limits.
- Confirm HSM key policy with security (Maya). Customer requires separate CMK per environment.
- Need to add CIDR 10.52.0.0/16 to allowlist for marlin-dev VPC.

Config snippets (keep in scratchpad):
- Worker pool tags: {"customer":"marlin-co","env":"prod","role":"inference-worker"}
- Autoscaling hint: target 70% GPU util for small bursts, reserve spare 10% for failover.

Quick commands I ran locally (reproduce later):
- aws ec2 describe-vpc-peering-connections --filters Name=tag:Customer,Values=marlin-co
- terraform plan -var=\"customer=marlin\" -out=plan-marlin
- ./inference-cli --host=https://private-redwood.marlin/api --model=gptl-v2-q8 --test-seq=40

Observations from test run (2026-03-10 11:12):
- gptl-v2-q8 average latency 95ms p50, 160ms p95 on single A10G (batching disabled). p95 > target when KV cache cold.
- Enabling prefix KV cache reduces p95 to ~110ms but increases memory pressure by 6%. Tradeoff: acceptable if we pin cache footprint.

Open questions for Monday sync:
- Does Marlin accept model quantization artifacts in their audit? (security needs answer)
- Which telemetry retention window do they want in Console? Default 14d or extend to 90d? Cost tradeoffs.
- Fallback behavior: confirm SLA if dedicated capacity is exhausted. Do we allow auto-fail to hosted with PII scrub? (legal)

Canary rollout (sketch):
- Step 0: dry run in dev with synthetic traffic (scorecard: latency, error-rate, cost-per-token).
- Step 1: 5% of traffic, 24h, real traffic shadowing + mirrored responses to logged bucket.
- Step 2: 25% for 48h, enable tracing hooks for token-level latency (Console).
- Step 3: 100% with 1h rapid rollback window.
- Fallback policy: if latency p95 > 150ms OR error-rate > 0.5% for 10m -> route to hosted small-gptl-v1 and notify SOC.

Customer-specific notes (Marlin):
- Compliance: they require SOC2-type logging and customer-managed KMS; want audit of all model versions used. Need to capture model version IDs per request in logs.
- They want per-route quotas for embedding calls to prevent accidental batch loads from their analytics team.

Action items (prio order):
1) Reserve AZ capacity & confirm ENI limits (Evan) -- due 2026-03-11.
2) Draft HSM CMK policy snippet for Marlin legal review (Maya + Priya) -- due 2026-03-12.
3) Run quantization sweep: compare q8 vs q4 on marlin sample prompts; collect p50/p95/cost delta (Priya) -- start today.
4) Add CIDR allowlist to staging peering (Priya) -- quick patch.
5) Create Console dashboard for per-route latency and cost (linked to project MAR-451) (Evan) -- need ETA.

Test plan for quantization sweep (notes):
- Input set: 120 representative prompts from Marlin's sanitized dataset (shared drive -> MARLIN/data/sanitized-samples.csv).
- Metrics: p50, p95, tokens-per-response, memory usage, decode errors, semantic fidelity (approx via BLEU-ish + human spot check).
- Run against A10G and T4-equivalent images to capture differences.

Quick troubleshooting checklist for rollout day:
- Verify CIDR routes and NAT gateway health.
- Confirm CMK policies applied and HSM access logs present.
- Ensure model version pinned in rollout request and that automatic fallback target configured.
- Check Console trace sampling rate; increase to 20% for first 2 steps.

Stale/low-priority notes (archive later):
- Consider offering Marlin a dedicated tokenizer cache if they have high repetition prompts. Might reduce GPU work.
- Pricing note: reserved capacity discount negotiation point: 18 months commit for 12% off baseline. Add to commercial convo.

End of day 2026-03-10 quick log (what I did):
- Ran baseline q8 latency tests, captured traces -> uploaded to MAR-451 ticket.
- Slack: pinged infra for AZ capacity, Evan acked.
- Drafted initial canary plan and pasted into Confluence page.

Next steps for tomorrow:
- Finish quantization sweep and prepare short slide (2-3 bullets) for customer kickoff.
- Sync with security about CMK audit requirements.
- Build a minimal runbook page in drive: title = "marlin-oncall-runbook-draft" and link from Confluence.
